name: Processing Status 106 Choice
definition: Choice of format for the processing status.

AcknowledgedAccepted.name: Acknowledged Accepted
AcknowledgedAccepted.definition: Request has been acknowledged by the account servicer.

Rejected.name: Rejected
Rejected.definition: Modification Request has been rejected for further processing.

Denied.name: Denied
Denied.definition: Modification request will not be executed.

Pending.name: Pending
Pending.definition: Modification is pending. It is not known at this time whether modification can be affected.

Proprietary.name: Proprietary
Proprietary.definition: Status that cannot be reported using one of the available standard status.
